status: Focused GCC13/GCC15 controls and GCC13 Valgrind pass; complete canonical GCC13 RPM and native builds remain required.
trigger: OBS revision1 failed on both architectures with GCC13 control-reaches-end-of-non-void-function. Local GCC15 canonical build did not diagnose this.
root_cause: DefaultPlatform::priority_from_index returned only inside a switch over a narrowed uint8_t enum. It lacked a terminating fallback, and invalid int indexes such as 256 or INT_MIN wrapped into valid priorities.
fix: Switch on the original int, use integer values of the named enum constants and terminate invalid indexes with V8 UNREACHABLE. PriorityMode::kDontApply retains its unconditional default mapping. Include logging.h directly.

tests.original_gcc13: Exact original header reproduces the missing-return compile failure with -Wall -Werror.
tests.negative_result: Every invalid applied-priority index aborts with the expected V8 unreachable diagnostic; core dumps disabled.
tests.in_rpm: Compile and execute the actual inline mapper, positive/default behavior and all invalid indexes on every architecture.
tests.metadata_tests: See raw six-test metadata and dependency test logs.

limits: No changed runtime sources submitted to OBS until canonical full qualification.
Compiler flags unchanged; no warning suppression.
The control uses standard explicit-template-instantiation access to call the actual private inline method on real DefaultPlatform objects.
